description: A Xiaomi omni-modal model for unified text, image, audio, and video understanding.

i18n.en: A Xiaomi omni-modal model for unified text, image, audio, and video understanding.
i18n.zh: 面向文本、图像、音频与视频统一理解的小米 MiMo 全模态模型。

description: A capable Xiaomi MiMo model for complex reasoning, coding, and agentic workloads.

i18n.en: A capable Xiaomi MiMo model for complex reasoning, coding, and agentic workloads.
i18n.zh: 面向复杂推理、编程与 Agent 工作负载的小米 MiMo 高性能模型。

description: Xiaomi's flagship MiMo model for software engineering and long-horizon agent tasks. The flagship emphasizes general agent capability, complex software engineering, and long-horizon execution.

i18n.en: Xiaomi's flagship MiMo model for software engineering and long-horizon agent tasks. The flagship emphasizes general agent capability, complex software engineering, and long-horizon execution.

description: A cost-efficient omni-modal MiMo model for agentic and visual understanding workloads. The native omni-modal design aims for Pro-level agent performance with more economical inference and stronger visual understanding.

i18n.en: A cost-efficient omni-modal MiMo model for agentic and visual understanding workloads. The native omni-modal design aims for Pro-level agent performance with more economical inference and stronger visual understanding.
i18n.zh: 兼顾成本与能力、适合 Agent 和视觉理解场景的 MiMo 全模态模型。原生全模态设计以更经济的推理成本提供接近 Pro 的 Agent 表现，并增强视觉理解。
